## File: facebookresearch_quaternet/short_term/pose_network_short_term.py

Prompts

```
['build a PoseNetworkShortTerm model with a specified prefix length for short-term human pose prediction', 'create batches of quaternion and Euler angle data from motion capture sequences for training', 'test the Euler angle L1 loss computation with 2pi wrap-around between predicted quaternions and expected angles', 'review the predict method that generates future pose frames from a given prefix sequence', 'summarize the PoseNetworkShortTerm class that extends PoseNetwork for short-term 3D human pose forecasting']
```
